nodes.summary: The Tribonacci word is written over the three-letter alphabet whose letters are $a$, $b$ and $c$.
nodes.title: The Tribonacci alphabet

nodes.summary: For every $n \ge 0$, the finite Tribonacci word $W(n + 3)$ is the concatenation $W(n + 2)\,W(n + 1)\,W(n)$.
nodes.title: Recursion for the finite Tribonacci words

nodes.summary: Writing $|w|$ for the length of a word $w$, for every $n \ge 0$ the finite Tribonacci words satisfy $|W(n + 3)| = |W(n + 2)| + |W(n + 1)| + |W(n)|$.
nodes.title: Length recurrence for finite Tribonacci words

nodes.summary: For every $n \ge 0$, the finite Tribonacci word $W(n)$ has length at least $n + 1$.
nodes.title: Length lower bound for finite Tribonacci words

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $m \le n$, the length of the finite Tribonacci word $W(m)$ is at most the length of $W(n)$.
nodes.title: Lengths of finite Tribonacci words are monotone

nodes.summary: For every $n \ge 0$, the finite Tribonacci word $W(n)$ is a prefix of $W(n + 1)$.
nodes.title: Each finite Tribonacci word is a prefix of the next

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $m \le n$, the finite Tribonacci word $W(m)$ is a prefix of $W(n)$.
nodes.title: Finite Tribonacci words form a prefix chain

nodes.summary: The finite Tribonacci words $W(n)$, for $n \ge 0$, are the words over the alphabet $\{a, b, c\}$ defined by $W(0) = a$, $W(1) = ab$, $W(2) = abac$ and $W(n + 3) = W(n + 2)\,W(n + 1)\,W(n)$ for every $n \ge 0$, where juxtaposition denotes concatenation.
nodes.title: Finite Tribonacci words

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $k \le n$ such that $k$ is less than the length of the finite Tribonacci word $W(n)$, the letter of $W(n)$ at position $k$ equals the letter of the infinite Tribonacci word at position $k$, positions being counted from $0$.
nodes.title: Finite Tribonacci words agree with the infinite word

nodes.summary: The infinite Tribonacci word is the sequence over the alphabet $\{a, b, c\}$ whose letter at each position $k \ge 0$ (positions counted from $0$) is the letter at position $k$ of the finite Tribonacci word $W(k)$; this position exists because $W(k)$ has length at least $k + 1$.
nodes.title: The infinite Tribonacci word

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
